questions.description: When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by Samsara Inc. and/or one of its subsidiaries (“Samsara”) using Greenhouse Software, Inc., a cloud services provider located in the United States of America ("Greenhouse"). Greenhouse is engaged by Samsara to help manage its recruitment and hiring processes. For more information about how your personal data will be processed by Samsara and any rights you may have, please review Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice at https://www.samsara.com/support/candidate-privacy-notice. If you have any questions about our privacy practices, please contact privacy@samsara.com.
